headline: Labor bleeding continues in manufacturing: employment fell 0.1% in September
summary: Mexican manufacturing employment dropped 0.1% in September and fell 0.9% year on year, extending 43 months of declines. Physical production volume contracted 4.8% in the month.
why: Manufacturing is a major part of Mexico's economy and export base, so weak output and jobs data are closely watched by investors.
original_headline: Sigue sangría laboral en manufactura: Empleo cayó 0.1% en septiembre
